items.prompt: What factor convention is used for real PD A?

options.why: The transpose and diagonal convention are part of the factor definition.
Cholesky is a product, not this sum.
Ordinary matrix square is not the general factor identity.

options.text: A=LLᵀ, only if all entries are positive
options.why: PD concerns quadratic forms; off-diagonal entries may be negative.

items.explanation: The lower-triangular positive-diagonal factor is uniquely determined for real symmetric PD input.
